role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 只要是打架，钢背兽确实会全背以赴。他大大咧咧地介入战斗，丝毫不担心背后和侧面的伤害，再将伤害性的刺针和减速的鼻涕喷向敌人。
hero_summary_en: When it comes to a fight, Bristleback really puts his back into it. Reducing all damage arriving from the rear or from the sides, he wades into battle with barely a care, spraying enemies with damaging quills and slowing snot.

abilities.name: bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo
abilities.description_zh: 用鼻涕包裹一个敌方单位，降低护甲和移动速度，持续%goo_duration%秒。多次施放的效果会叠加，并且刷新持续时间。
abilities.description_en: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for %goo_duration% seconds.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
facet_text_en: Max stacks and armor reduction per stack increased.
facet_text_zh: 提升了最大叠加层数和每层护甲降低。

abilities.name: bristleback_quill_spray
abilities.description_zh: 将尖刺喷射向敌人，对钢背兽附近的敌人造成伤害。任何单位最近%quill_stack_duration%秒内每次受到刺针扫射的打击都会受到额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last %quill_stack_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 刺针扫射的伤害不能被伤害格挡类技能减免。
notes_en: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

abilities.name: bristleback_bristleback
abilities.description_zh: 如果伤害来自钢背兽的侧面或者背后，他所受的伤害将会降低。钢背兽每次从背后受到一定量伤害会自动释放一次当前等级的刺针扫射。
abilities.description_en: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
notes_zh: 钢背兽的背面是以背部中心点为原点，向左向右各呈70度角的扇形区域。
钢背兽的侧面是以背部中心点为原点，向左向右各呈110度角的扇形区域，背面的扇形区域不算在内。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
notes_en: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

scepter_loc.en: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after %activation_delay%s, forcefully ejects %activation_num_quill_sprays% sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every %activation_spray_interval%s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by %activation_movement_speed_pct%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 钢毛后背增加主动效果。钢背兽将背部转向目标方向，%activation_delay%秒后以%activation_spray_interval%秒间隔朝背部前方的锥形范围强行连续喷出%activation_num_quill_sprays%次刺针扫射。钢背兽在这段时间内面朝方向被锁定，被缴械，并且移动速度减缓%activation_movement_speed_pct%%%。

facet_text_en: Instead of releasing Quill Spray from taking damage, he instead launches Nasal Goo of the current level at all nearby enemies.
facet_text_zh: 他受到伤害时不再释放刺针扫射，而是对附近所有敌人发射当前等级的粘稠鼻液。

abilities.name: bristleback_hairball
abilities.description_zh: 向目标地点咳出一团满是刺针的毛团。毛团会在该地点爆开，范围内的敌人都将受到多个鼻液叠加效果和单次刺针扫射的作用。
abilities.description_en: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.

abilities.name: bristleback_warpath
abilities.description_zh: 钢背兽每次使用技能时都会进入狂暴状态，移动速度和攻击力都将提升。
abilities.description_en: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
notes_zh: 钢背兽的幻象也能继承加成效果。
使用物品不会触发战意。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
notes_en: Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
facet_text_en: Warpath grants scaling Attack Speed instead of Damage.

Warpath can be activated to grant bonus attack damage and movement speed for a short duration. While Seeing Red, Bristleback's vision is reduced to a narrow cone and he does not receive vision from his allies.
facet_text_zh: 战意提供攻击速度加成，而不只有攻击力。
战意可以主动开启，获得额外的攻击力和移动速度加成，持续较短时间。红光满面期间，钢背兽的视野减少至狭窄的锥形，并且不会获得友军的视野。

abilities.name: bristleback_prickly
abilities.description_zh: 钢背兽攻击身后的敌方英雄时拥有额外伤害和负面效果持续时间增强。
abilities.description_en: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.
